long_biography.plain_text:
Chemezov's early career included research on rare and non-ferrous metals and an overseas assignment with the Luch industrial association in East Germany. Russia's presidential property administration and Promexport followed, before he took charge of the state arms exporter Rosoboronexport.

The Russian government appointed him to lead the newly created Russian Technologies state corporation in 2007. Renamed Rostec, the institution brought hundreds of industrial enterprises into a single state-controlled group and coordinated their restructuring. Its remit grew across aviation, engineering, electronics, medical technology and defence production, with Chemezov responsible for the corporation's long-term strategy and management.
long_biography.html:
Chemezov's early career included research on rare and non-ferrous metals and an overseas assignment with the Luch industrial association in East Germany. Russia's presidential property administration and Promexport followed, before he took charge of the state arms exporter Rosoboronexport.

The Russian government appointed him to lead the newly created Russian Technologies state corporation in 2007. Renamed Rostec, the institution brought hundreds of industrial enterprises into a single state-controlled group and coordinated their restructuring. Its remit grew across aviation, engineering, electronics, medical technology and defence production, with Chemezov responsible for the corporation's long-term strategy and management.
